scope: Independent bounded source-only review of exact frozen five-file retained count/encoder/emission component; not a retained MaterializeCandidate/public ACK qualification.

manifest_verification.method: Read and hash each exact packet file; verify bytes and SHA256 against manifest.

checks.conclusion: Ordinary nil wrappers drain the SAME retained count, emission and encode core. Prior recursive/encoding bodies are removed rather than retained as competing authority.

Header fields, child entries, canonical clear and checksum match prior encoding. Chunk retirement summary and output packing now share one retained256-slot loop; index validation/packing share one16-slot loop. Independent decoder bodies are unchanged.

Count/emission use fixed canonical-depth frame arrays. Node and child traversal, page allocation, encoding and sink phases retain cursors; finite encoding batches only admitted entries. Fixed page clear/checksum primitives are admitted at page size.

Finite recording accepts only the concrete production validation sink and typed ledger transition; opaque sinks/callbacks are refused. Map probe and insertion phases retain progress; vector growth is admitted as the actual indivisible unit, yielding explicit UnitTooLarge when it cannot fit.

Emission binds exact root/generation/next pointer/sink. It stores the first error and returns it before replaying assignments or sink writes. Partial failure remains within consumed candidate ownership and existing ledger tail-attempt semantics.

Every emitted candidate page has fresh independent storage because CandidatePageWriter may retain views. Only controls are reused; output is not reset at Prepare/publication. Generic ordinary sinks retain their isolated copies. Existing encode-Into caller output reuse remains supported. No new pool, arena or second allocator.

Tests cover retained count/emission versus ordinary entry points, canonical reference page bytes, unchanged decoder invariants, independent page storage, opaque finite refusal before page-ID effects and sticky first failure. Existing generic-sink and tail-failure controls are retained.

prior_format_reference.meaning: All five selected controls actually PASS while prior format supplies independent encodeChunkPage/encodeIndexPage reference bodies; new retained encoder/emitter remains active.

candidate_freelist.meaning: Same five controls PASS; all four canonical page SHA256 values equal the independent reference run; retained emission completes in27 calls.

candidate_public_promotion.meaning: Exact test actually runs and PASSes on candidate compiler inputs; proves ordinary public promotion control, not native bounded ACK.

limits: No reviewer Go, benchmark/profile runs, native source writes, Git/GitHub writes or cleanup.
Acceptance covers only these exact five frozen component files and inspected supporting contracts; live owner edits are excluded.
MaterializeCandidate retained constructor, reservation normalization/chain/header and remaining closure stages are intentionally not implemented or qualified here.
Production native ACK remains0. Public promotion control and internal finite emission tests are not native public activation proof.
No performance acceptance or quantified speed/allocation claim; ordinary public performance guard may proceed without architecture changes demanded by this review.
Large map/vector backing growth remains an honestly indivisible, potentially over-Q32 operation with explicit refusal; general Q32 completion is not claimed.
